speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing swelling in your right knee and have a family history of similar issues. To better understand your condition, can you describe exactly how the pain started and if it was triggered by an injury?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia (likely Hemophilia B given the age of presentation and spontaneous onset without trauma).

I have asked 1 question. I need to confirm the bleeding pattern and family history details to be sure. Did the swelling involve any bruising or bleeding from other sites like the gums or nose? Also, do you know if any male relatives on the mother's side had bleeding disorders?
